messages.content: Remove "Planning" view and menu entries. Not used anymore

**Confirmed:** the Planning view lived only in `client/src/components/kanban/board/KanbanBoardView.vue` (import + `activeView === 'planning'` branch + `viewTabs` entry + the `KANBAN_VIEWS`/`VALID_VIEWS` whitelists). **Ruled out:** no other menu/registry references "planning" in the client — the remaining `planning` usages are the Vuex store and `PlanningRangeFilter.vue`, both still needed by **Follow-up**.

## What happened

1. The board offered a `Planning` tab (Board / Table / Planning / Follow-up) backed by `PlanningView.vue`.
2. It is no longer used, so the tab, its menu entry and its whitelisting had to go without breaking Follow-up.

## What I did

- `client/src/components/kanban/board/KanbanBoardView.vue`: removed `import PlanningView`, removed the `<PlanningView>` render branch (Follow-up is now the `v-if` branch), dropped `'planning'` from `KANBAN_VIEWS` and `VALID_VIEWS`, removed the `Planning` entry from `viewTabs`, and cleaned the comments that still described a planning view. Any stale `?view=planning` link now falls back to the table view instead of erroring.
- Kept `src/store/planning.js` and `PlanningRangeFilter.vue` — `FollowupView.vue` still uses both.

## Demo

Open a kanban board: the view switcher shows only **Board / Table / Follow-up**.

## Next tasks

- `quick` — delete the now-orphaned `client/src/components/kanban/board/PlanningView.vue` (I have no file-delete tool here; `git rm client/src/components/kanban/board/PlanningView.vue` does it) and optionally trim the planning-store dataset loader.
- `quick` — the QA gate blocked on **1 failing test in the API suite** (`pytest:api`, 1708 passed / 1 failed) which is unrelated to this Vue-only change — worth confirming it is pre-existing.
- `max` — full client build + UI smoke through the browser to confirm Follow-up still renders with its range filter.

**Good enough?** ok / next / what is wrong — `ok` ships it, `next` takes the first next task, `what is wrong` fixes this one.
